title: I built Core-Zone, an old-school browser war RPG
author: Beautiful-Revenue232
selftext:
Hey [r/PBBG](https://www.reddit.com/r/PBBG/),

I've been working on **Core-Zone**, an old-school browser-based military RPG focused on progression, PvP, barracks, trading and player rivalries.

**Play:** [https://warfare.cz/](https://warfare.cz/)

A **fresh round started October 1st**, so everyone is still building, ranking and establishing themselves.

If you grew up playing browser RPGs where you'd log in throughout the day, build your account, watch the rankings and inevitably make a few enemies along the way, that's the kind of experience I'm trying to capture.

You start as a **Recruit** and work your way through the military ranks with the ultimate goal of reaching **General of the Army**.

Some of the main features currently include:

* **PvP combat** — hunt rival soldiers, plan attacks and protect yourself
* **Barracks** — create or join one, build alliances and fight alongside other players
* **Bunkers** — disappear into protection when things get a little too hot
* **Player economy** — earn, bank and manage your money
* **Trading** — buy and sell bullets and gold with other players
* **Properties** — build up income-producing assets
* **Crimes & compounds** — earn EXP and develop your soldier
* **Weapons and progression** — strengthen your account as you move through the ranks
* **Competitive rankings** — see how you stack up against everyone else

There's **nothing to download or install** — it runs directly in the browser.

**A fresh round has just begun**

The current round started on **1 October 2026**, so this is a good time to join before the round matures and the top players pull further ahead.

**I'd genuinely like feedback from PBBG players**

Core-Zone is actively being developed, and I'd really value feedback from people who already enjoy this type of game.

If you give it a try, I'd particularly like to know:

* Was it obvious what to do after registering?
* How does the early-game progression feel?
* Is anything confusing or unnecessarily slow?
* What do you think of the PvP and barrack mechanics?
* What would make you want to come back tomorrow?
* What features do you think it's missing?

Positive or negative, useful criticism is welcome.

**Play Core-Zone:**  
[https://warfare.cz/](https://warfare.cz/)

Thanks for taking a look — and if you do join, good luck. Just don't be surprised if somebody decides your properties look profitable. :)
